title: Hearty Portuguese Cheese Lasagna
description: A yeasty, cheese-pull, nostalgic Portuguese dish featuring green cardamom pods and dashi-extract, made low-sodium-friendly. This lasagna is perfect for a special occasion or a cozy night in.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the crushed green cardamom pods and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked noodles, shredded cheese, dashi-extract, and sauteed onion mixture.
In a separate bowl, combine the chopped spinach and a pinch of salt and pepper.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a thin layer of the cheese mixture and top with a layer of noodles.
Repeat the layers two more times, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
